source_policy: Original query only, existing Seznam/Naver; no extra search/scraping API. No app/download queries; andro.io/subdomains blocked and never eligible for validation. Model/key/Qwen settings trusted startup only.

observed_union.identity: sha256(case_id+newline+canonical requested/original URL)[:16]; canonical strips www/tracking/trailing slash as existing tooling; redirect targets retained as provenance, not silently merged
observed_union.read: Every successful HTTP2xx source document with body text_hash and no error in news_navigation/page_verification documents, regardless runtime kind/date or returned membership; trace-specific IDs retained hidden
observed_union.returned: Every actual returned result, including unreviewed or unfetched sources
observed_union.blind: All READ+returned case/URL tokens, with source-only URL/title/snippet cards and exact primary original variants; no arm/model/runtime date/type/classification/read-or-returned flags. Native source/body variants kept when arms differ.
observed_union.missing: Any unavailable/failed/unread/over-cap returned potential article remains in cards/gold as unknown; every successful READ native original retained. Failed reads not made positives or forced negatives.

evidence: short exact source quote with path/URL

annotation.grade2: Specific full original article matches requested city/topic/site and full own publication date in window, no date after as_of. Runtime kind/eligible/direct is never source gold.
annotation.grade1: Feed/navigation or useful clearly incomplete material, never an eligible full news article. Missing original or unresolved essential date is unknown unless independently clear wrong place/topic/period.
annotation.grade0: Source clearly wrong place/topic/site/period or app advertisement for news-reading intent; card-only 0/1 marked provisional. Controls may produce positive sources if actually suitable; no expected score is imposed.
annotation.unknown: Original absent/inaccessible, source insufficient, own full publication date unresolved, or validation cap exhausted; excluded from known-positive denominator and separate from FP.
date_rules: Full own Article/NewsArticle publication date bound to article identity; never query/URL/copyright/clock/adjacent teaser/year inference.
Modified/event/other-entity dates are not publication; nested/foreign dates not accepted as own.
Date/time offsets consistently converted to Moscow calendar.
Today exactly2026-11-03; nd07/12 exactly2026-11-02; nd09 November2025; future publication cannot qualify as of2026-11-03.
annotation.dedup: Per-case canonical URL; repeated source across queries counts case/URL, with separate event/publisher cluster disclosures.
annotation.gold_freeze: Blind source-only annotators inspect all primary captured variants for a URL. Freeze labels before prediction join; no arm/model/runtime verdicts. If variants disagree materially on suitability, mark unknown and disclose; primary grade2 requires all supplied complete variants suitable (unavailable variants remain missing, not invented negatives).

recall.denominator: Every known-grade2 case/URL in successful READ union plus returned union of BOTH arms, only cases executed successfully by BOTH arms. Same denominator per arm.
recall.numerator: Denominator URLs actually returned as direct by this arm in top10.
recall.fn: Denominator minus numerator, including read-but-not-returned and URLs only observed by opposite arm.
recall.secondary: paired_returned_union_gold_direct_recall, same prior definition, separately labelled and not substituted for primary.
recall.undefined: null before gold, without paired cases, or zero known positives; never made-up0/100.
recall.unknowns: All observed/unknown union counts plus per-arm missing originals; unknown direct separate from known FP. Known-positive-only denominator can still understate opportunities when cap/unknown sources remain.
recall.limits: Conditional known-positive observed READ+returned corpus, not candidate-pool/full-web recall. Live source variants can differ; disagreements become unknown and are disclosed. Shared CLI/MCP run/public_result is code-backed, not proof of deployment/transport equivalence under all conditions.

extra_validation.budget: Primary native --output captures READ HTML/docs at zero extraHTTP. Up to8 optional unread unique targets separately reported, including actual HTTP attempts/hops/errors.
extra_validation.method_limit: READ originals are exact native primary capture bytes. Any optional unread returned originals come later and are explicitly marked as such, not primary input.
